title: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἄρτον ἀγοράζει
learning_goal: Practice infinitive complements with δεῖ and βούλομαι, alongside trade verbs (ἀγοράζω, πωλέω) and basic need vocabulary (πεινᾷ), within a simple market errand.
plot: A hungry Dinosaur finds coins at home, goes to the agora, pays a friendly merchant for bread, and eats until he is no longer hungry.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐστίν. πεινᾷ· βούλεται φαγεῖν τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: a low round wooden table with a smooth oak surface and sturdy legs at child height
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur stands in the left foreground in three-quarter view facing right toward the table, eyes looking down at the coins with a hopeful, hungry expression.
The low round wooden table sits center midground, top visible from a slight overhead angle.
The small brown cloth sack rests on the right edge of the table, drawstring loose, angled toward Dinosaur.
The several small round silver coins lie clustered near the center of the table, glinting in the warm light.
motivations: Dinosaur’s stomach is empty and he wants to eat bread, so he looks hopefully at anything that might help him get food.
frames.artist_notes: Warm interior light; keep the room cozy and simple so the table, coins, and sack read clearly.

frames.text: ζητεῖ τὸν ἄρτον, ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἄρτος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.
objects: a low round wooden table with a smooth oak surface and sturdy legs at child height
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur is still left foreground, now leaning slightly back from the table in three-quarter view, eyes scanning the room and then back to the table, puzzled.
The low round wooden table remains center midground, unchanged in angle and placement.
The small brown cloth sack remains on the right edge of the table, drawstring loose.
The several small round silver coins remain clustered at the center of the table, untouched.
motivations: Dinosaur has searched for bread inside but found none, so he looks around uncertainly and a bit disappointed.
frames.artist_notes: Hold the composition from the previous frame for continuity; let Dinosaur’s head motion suggest searching.

frames.text: δεῖ ἀγοράζειν τὸν ἄρτον· δεῖ ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a low round wooden table with a smooth oak surface and sturdy legs at child height
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur shifts closer to the table in three-quarter view facing right, right hand reaching toward the sack while glancing toward the doorway off-frame with a determined look.
The low round wooden table remains center midground, top visible.
The small brown cloth sack lies on the right edge of the table, slightly wrinkled, within Dinosaur’s reach.
The several small round silver coins sit near the table center, just ahead of Dinosaur’s reach.
motivations: Realizing there is no bread at home, Dinosaur decides it is necessary to go to the market to buy bread and looks resolute.
frames.artist_notes: Subtle body language shift from uncertainty to determination; keep warm interior light consistent.

frames.text: εὑρίσκει ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης τὰ νομίσματα· λαμβάνει καὶ τίθησιν εἰς τὸν σάκκον.
objects: a low round wooden table with a smooth oak surface and sturdy legs at child height
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur stands close at the table, three-quarter view facing right, left hand holding the sack open while right hand scoops the coins, eyes focused on the coins.
The low round wooden table remains center midground, steady in angle.
The small brown cloth sack is on the table’s right edge, mouth open toward Dinosaur’s hands.
The several small round silver coins are mid-motion between the table center and the open sack, a few still on the tabletop.
motivations: Dinosaur needs money to buy bread, so he carefully gathers the coins into the sack to prepare for the trip.
frames.artist_notes: Show a couple of coins mid-air to emphasize action; keep continuity of layout.

frames.text: ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας καὶ φέρει τὸν σάκκον.
objects: a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
a winding cobblestone path leading from the door toward town
positioning: Dinosaur steps from the doorway in rightward three-quarter view, eyes forward along the path, holding the sack at his side.
The small brown cloth sack hangs from Dinosaur’s right hand near his hip, drawstring gently pulled closed.
The winding cobblestone path begins at the threshold in the foreground and curves off to the right toward town.
motivations: With coins secured, Dinosaur heads out carrying the sack, eager to reach the market for bread.
frames.artist_notes: Bright sunlight outside; keep the cozy house visible behind to connect with previous interior.

frames.text: βαίνει ἐπὶ τῇ ὁδῷ εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
a winding cobblestone path leading from the door toward town
positioning: Dinosaur is mid-path in profile walking to the right, eyes focused ahead with a purposeful stride.
The small brown cloth sack bounces lightly against Dinosaur’s side as he walks, drawstring closed.
The winding cobblestone path stretches from the left background (house) to the right foreground, guiding the movement.
motivations: Dinosaur is on his way to buy bread, so he walks with determination and focus.
frames.artist_notes: Use a gentle follow-shot feel; add small garden details receding to emphasize movement.

frames.text: ἔρχεται πρὸς τὴν ἀγοράν καὶ εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
positioning: Dinosaur climbs the stoa steps in three-quarter view facing right, eyes up toward the colonnade entrance.
The small brown cloth sack hangs at Dinosaur’s right side as he steps upward, ready for use.
motivations: Dinosaur sees the market and moves inside, anticipating buying bread soon.
frames.artist_notes: Show Doric columns and sunny steps; keep the sack clearly visible against Dinosaur’s green body.

frames.text: βαίνει πρὸς τὸν Ἔμπορον. ὁ Ἔμπορος πωλεῖ τὸν ἄρτον καὶ τὰ μῆλα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ.
objects: a tidy wooden market table with baskets and a small blue-painted sign
a round golden-brown loaf of bread with a lightly scored top on a wooden board
a pile of shiny red apples inside a woven wicker basket
a clay jug of clear water with a cork stopper and simple painted band
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur approaches from the left midground in three-quarter view facing right, eyes on the merchant and the goods.
Emporos stands behind the market table center midground, three-quarter view facing left toward Dinosaur, smiling.
The tidy wooden market table sits between them, front edge parallel to the frame.
The round golden-brown loaf of bread rests atop a small wooden board near the table center front.
The pile of shiny red apples fills a woven basket on the left side of the table.
The clay jug of clear water stands on the right side of the table near Emporos’ hand.
The small brown cloth sack hangs at Dinosaur’s right hip, drawstring closed.
The several small round silver coins are inside the sack, not visible but implied by its weight.
motivations: Dinosaur is hungry and wants to buy bread, so he heads straight to the seller’s table with interest.
Emporos is a cheerful merchant ready to sell bread, apples, and water to the new customer approaching.
frames.artist_notes: Soft daylight filters through the stoa; keep table items neatly arranged and readable from child height.

frames.text: λαμβάνει ἐκ τοῦ σάκκου τὰ νομίσματα· δίδωσιν τῷ Ἐμπόρῳ καὶ ἀγοράζει τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: a tidy wooden market table with baskets and a small blue-painted sign
a round golden-brown loaf of bread with a lightly scored top on a wooden board
a pile of shiny red apples inside a woven wicker basket
a clay jug of clear water with a cork stopper and simple painted band
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the table edge in three-quarter view facing right, left hand opening the sack while right hand extends coins toward Emporos.
Emporos leans slightly forward behind the table, right hand open to accept the coins, eyes kind.
The tidy wooden market table remains centered, front edge straight.
The round golden-brown loaf of bread sits within Emporos’ reach on the small board at center front.
The pile of shiny red apples remains in the woven basket at the left side of the table.
The clay jug of clear water remains at the right side of the table near Emporos.
The small brown cloth sack hangs open from Dinosaur’s left hand, mouth tilted upward.
The several small round silver coins are between Dinosaur’s right hand and Emporos’ open hand, a few already above the table.
motivations: Dinosaur wants the bread and is paying with the coins he brought, feeling hopeful and focused.
Emporos is happy to make a fair sale and reaches to take the payment and give the bread.
frames.artist_notes: Keep hands and coins clearly visible; maintain consistent table layout and lighting.

frames.text: ὁ Ἔμπορος δίδωσιν τὸν ἄρτον τῷ Δεινοσαύρῳ. ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐσθίει· νῦν οὐ πεινᾷ.
objects: a tidy wooden market table with baskets and a small blue-painted sign
a round golden-brown loaf of bread with a lightly scored top on a wooden board
a pile of shiny red apples inside a woven wicker basket
a clay jug of clear water with a cork stopper and simple painted band
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the table in three-quarter view facing right, holding the loaf with both hands and taking a happy bite, eyes bright.
Emporos stands behind the table, hand just released after giving the loaf, smiling warmly at Dinosaur.
The tidy wooden market table remains centered, front edge straight.
The round golden-brown loaf of bread is now in Dinosaur’s hands with a small bite missing.
The pile of shiny red apples remains in the woven basket on the left side of the table.
The clay jug of clear water remains on the right side of the table, undisturbed.
The small brown cloth sack hangs closed at Dinosaur’s side again.
The several small round silver coins now lie in a small stack on the table near Emporos’ side.
motivations: Dinosaur has finally received bread and eats happily, relieved that he is no longer hungry.
Emporos is pleased with the successful sale and satisfied to see the customer content.
frames.artist_notes: Show a clear bite mark in the loaf; keep expressions joyful and satisfied; maintain the same stall arrangement.
